explication: ECC is an agent-harness operating system for coordinating coding agents across multiple harnesses. The principal workflow is: an operator starts or dispatches a session, ECC configures and runs agents, coordinates delegated work and worktrees, applies review and verification gates, records observability and memory, then returns status and findings through the CLI or dashboard. The sampled files strongly support session orchestration, TUI control, risk logging, review workflows, hooks, and persistent state; several README-level integrations are represented only at their documented module or directory boundaries.
